definitions.gloss: to succeed, to be successful, to achieve success
definitions.explanation: To accomplish a goal, achieve a desired result, or attain success in an endeavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実験|じっけん}→実験：03273_jikken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成功|せいこう}した。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成功|せいこう}させた。
examples.english: He made the business a success after much effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{成功|せいこう}して⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: They failed many times, but in the end succeeded and drew attention from around the world.

notes:
A compound of {成|せい} (to become, to achieve) and {功|こう} (merit, achievement). One of the most fundamental words for expressing success. The noun form ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧ is equally common. The causative form {成功|せいこう}させる (to make something succeed) is frequently used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{成功|せいこう}: great success
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: to achieve success
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: experience of success
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秘訣|ひけつ}→秘訣：13750_hiketsu⟧: the secret to success
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: success rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いく: to go well — casual, everyday expression for things working out
- ⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧: to achieve, to accomplish — focuses on reaching a specific goal or target
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fail — the antonym
